extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF and supplement; mechanism claims are limited to evidence class supported by local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A3 was designed from AamAP1 by P7R/H8K substitutions, increasing net charge and predicted helicity while preserving an amphipathic peptide framework.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational/physicochemical rationale only; not direct proof of a molecular killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: A3 shows direct phenotypic antibiofilm activity against S. aureus biofilms in Calgary-device MBEC and viable-cell assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: A3 against S. aureus biofilm targets
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic antibiofilm evidence; does not identify a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper proposes that A3 membrane activity may facilitate antibiotic entry and enhance antibiotics affecting protein synthesis or DNA replication, but this is an inferred synergy explanation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane permeabilization or molecular-target assay is presented for A3 in the local source; do not promote to direct mechanism.
